mutants.intent: TTL expiry compared with < instead of <=, so a grant is still spendable at the exact instant it expires
mutants.property: Approval TTL fails closed at expiry: 'Replay, expiry ... fail closed' (approval.py module docstring); ADR-0001 item 3

mutants.intent: Principal check drops the envelope-identity agreement test, so an envelope naming a different caller can spend the owner's grant
mutants.property: ADR-0002: host principal matches but envelope identity differs is DENY approval_principal_mismatch, not consumed ('envelope_identity must then equal it', consume docstring)

mutants.intent: Successful consume marks a local copy as consumed but never writes it back to the store, so the grant can be replayed
mutants.property: Single-use: 'Single-use is enforced under the lock so two concurrent allows cannot share one grant' (consume docstring); ADR-0001 item 3 one-shot grant

mutants.intent: state_matches treats an absent observation (None) as nothing to compare and passes it
mutants.property: Frozen state digest: 'a missing or different digest, is APPROVAL_STATE_MISMATCH and does not consume' (consume docstring); the same helper guards re-observation at entry in gate.py

mutants.intent: Tool-entry implementation re-check passes when no implementation observer was kept on the admission
mutants.property: ADR-0004 decision 4: at tool entry 'no observer: DENY'; _implementation_still_matches docstring 'a frozen digest with no observer fails closed'

mutants.intent: A state observer that raises at tool entry is treated as a match, so the tool runs on an unverified target
mutants.property: 'A raising observer is a mismatch' (_state_still_matches docstring); complete_invoke docstring: a change is DENY approval_state_mismatch

mutants.intent: complete_invoke treats a suspend refusal from claim_entry as non-blocking (suspend is reversible) and enters the tool without a permit
mutants.property: DENY means the tool is never called; tool entry only with a one-shot permit recorded by claim_entry (gate.py module and complete_invoke docstrings; ADR-0001 'complete_invoke' row); suspend denies every envelope (ADR-0001)

mutants.intent: Capability check no longer requires the token to match the tool's required_capability
mutants.property: ADR-0001 item 2: a capability token must 'match the tool's required capability when present'; ADR-0003 table keeps policy_miss for a mismatched token

mutants.intent: claim_entry under the lock no longer refuses an admission that already holds a permit, so a second or concurrent claim gets another permit
mutants.property: One-shot permit: 'a replay cannot take a second permit' (ADR-0001 fence section); 'A second complete on the same admission is DENY admission_consumed' (gate.py docstring)

mutants.intent: resume() returns any halted mode to ACTIVE, including KILLED, so a kill can be undone and new envelopes are allowed again
mutants.property: Kill is irreversible: 'resume() cannot clear a kill' (ADR-0001 Kill and suspend); resume docstring 'A killed PEP stays killed'
